figures.caption: Table 1: Performance on ALFWorld and WebShop. Results are averaged over 3 random seeds. For ALFWorld, we report the average success rate (%) for each subtask as well as the overall result. For WebShop, we report both the average score and the average success rate (%). The best and second-best results are bold and underlined. Methods highlighted in gray are our implemented results. The remaining results are adopted from GiGPO (Feng et al., 2025) and EMPG (Wang et al., 2025a).
